decisions.reason: The optical spectrum service reflects heavy infrastructure investment and was promoted on the home page in 2019, so it sits at the core of the firm's announced wholesale fibre direction, and management would hold onto it and blame any weak uptake on temporary market conditions.

The voice number ordering portal is a low-cost operational tool that was still listed in 2019 and supports existing wholesale voice customers, but legacy voice products such as E and F have already been cut, so there is some risk it is dropped even though the sunk effort and service commitment favour keeping it.
